title: Mária Terézia és az 1741-es pozsonyi országgyűlés (Maria Theresa & Hungary)
grammar: Postpositions of Instrumentality (által, révén) and Enlightened Reforms

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can tell how Maria Theresa became ruler and what happened at the Diet of Pozsony in 1741.
I can use the -val/-vel ending to say how something was done, as in hűségesküvel.
I can say that the 'Vitam et sanguinem' scene is a tradition that historians question.
I can use eight new words about Maria Theresa's accession.
